assessment: The patch introduces a read-only terminal projection that strips terminal evidence at SSE ingestion and persists-cache restore, coalesces paused SSE events into a single canonical read with at-most-one pending refresh (no dropped-event race loss), and validates durable disposition/resume-actor consistency before projection. Protected predicates (executing count, native WIP, Up Next ceiling) are tested to remain intact. Board projection is intentionally a display-only lane preserving task.column and allTasks membership. The terminalDisplay field is a display-only snapshot, not a lifecycle column or release authorization, and dispatch/drag/bulk authority is not attached. No concrete defect observed.
